name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Horchata Latto
description:
Creamy, sweet, and smooth as can be. The Mad Labs Horchata Latto disposable packs a full 2 grams of premium oil into a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Horchata Latto delivers that unmistakable dessert-drink vibe: creamy vanilla and sweet rice-milk richness up front, warmed by a soft cinnamon-spice finish. It's a smooth, indulgent flavor with balanced hybrid effects — a gentle, even-keeled lift that relaxes the body while keeping your head clear and easy. Great for any time of day when you want to take the edge off without tipping too far in either direction.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Horchata Latto flavor — creamy vanilla and rice milk with a hint of cinnamon
Balanced hybrid effects — smooth, mellow, and easygoing any time of day

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Horchata Latto is ready whenever you are.
